_comment: MESA inheritance levels a profile can be authored at, most specific first. Pinned against const.MESA_SCOPES, the panel's MesaProfileScope union, its label maps and list table, and the in-context injector's own scope set. Deployment defaults are not a keyed level and are deliberately absent.
_injector_comment: The subset the in-context injector decorates on Home Assistant's own pages. Entity scope rides the config data tables; device, area and integration are subpage-header buttons. Domain has no Home Assistant page to hang one on.
